sloka: तं राक्षसात्मजं चक्रे मातुरेव वयःसमम् ।अमरं चैव तं कृत्वा महादेवो ऽक्षरो ऽव्ययः ।। ७.४.२९ ॥
transliteration: taṁ rākṣasātmajaṁ cakre mātureva vayaḥsamam ।amaraṁ caiva taṁ kṛtvā mahādevo 'kṣaro 'vyayaḥ ।। 7.4.29 ॥

translations.english: The imperishable and immutable Lord Mahadeva made that son of the demon, Sukesha, immortal and equal in age to his mother.
